gen-dafont-minecraftia-gf-graduate: Minecraftia sets its tall lowercase down one blocky character per beat, with dense stems and hairline details. Graduate comes in bookish and generous with white space, its capitals and lowercase nearly level, every stroke the same weight.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-graduate: Ancient and powerful, Nordic packs closed, tightly folded letters into a single stroke weight, each one placed far from the next. But Graduate, a text serif, opens its letters wide and spaces them generously, dignified and bookish.
gen-eater-gf-cascadia-mono: Cascadia Mono stands its letters like pins in a wide board. Eater, dark and aggressive, earns its keep big and brief, where its mild thick-thin shifts and short ascenders can show off.
gen-eater-gf-julius-sans-one: Julius Sans One reads like outlines drawn in a single width, with wide gaps and curves left open at the ends. Eater is the dark, spiky partner, while Julius Sans One stays clean and approachable, and that difference between them is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-eater-gf-lexend-exa: Aggressive and dark, Eater sprawls with wide gaps and a faint thick-thin shift in its strokes. Lexend Exa then reads in a plain sans pen that never changes pressure, with big x-height letters and stubby ascenders carrying a longer passage steadily.
gen-dafont-disorder-archivo: Disorder scatters raw, widely spaced glyphs whose n arches are as thick as their stems, with a tall lowercase that looks big. Archivo, a plain sans, opens its curves outward.
gen-dafont-groovy-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Groovy is friendly and funky, its loosely tracked lowercase leaving the c a narrow slit that almost closes. And Be Vietnam Pro, a plain sans, keeps its curve endings far apart, so a longer passage moves like a bent steel rod, smooth and open.
gen-dafont-minecraftia-fs-merriweather-s: Minecraftia lingers on each character, one beat at a time, with fine threads attached to its chunky stems. Merriweather Sans makes words look sturdy and large, its e opening clearly.
gen-flavors-gf-cascadia-code: Whimsical and stubby, with towering lowercase. Cascadia Code follows as a smooth monoline wire, wide-spaced, so a longer passage glides around each bend without snagging.
gen-flavors-gf-julius-sans-one: Whimsical Flavors swaggers in with diagonals as heavy as its stems and a towering lowercase. Julius Sans One, a plain sans, feels light and spaced out beside it.
